transport: macOS CoreBluetooth / Bleak 0.22.3 / VESC Nordic UART
scope: Read commands 0/4/14/17/32, motor-current command 6, finite application-output timer command 63. No VESC configuration, flash, firmware, reset, detection or CAN-forwarding commands.
notes: Source modification timestamps identify the local trace files, not precise motor actuation times.
Scripts evolved between trials. Early result=completed means the loop finished, not that all acceptance criteria passed. See README for the first 1 A probe guard defect.
Latest script includes tapered current; the earlier 5 A trials used on/off current below 150 ERPM.
An initial 30-second connection attempt found no BLE peripheral and sent no commands; it has no telemetry trace. The included 10 A trace is the subsequent actual attempt.
